headline: Anbernic shows off new dual-screen handheld built for 3DS emulation
summary: Anbernic shared a new video of its upcoming dual-screen handheld playing 3DS, Xbox and PS3 games through emulation. Its main display has a 5:3 aspect ratio, suited to 3DS games, with a 4:3 bottom screen. The device follows Anbernic's existing RG DS and RG DS Plus dual-screen handhelds, a category rivals like Ayaneo have also pursued.
